_comment: Jarvis user config. NEVER commit real API keys — use env var references. Phase 1: one user. Phase 2: one of many.

capital._note: allocated_usd = what Jarvis may trade with. reserved_usd = held back, never touched.

risk._note: Turtle 2% per trade. Halt trading if daily loss ≥ 6% or drawdown ≥ 15%.

pairs._note: Phase 1: conservative majors only. Pairlist audit will expand/refine this.

strategies._note: Signal-generator only emits for strategies listed here. Strategy IDs must exist in strategies/registry.json.

regime_filter._note: Default: skip trading in the extremes. Override per-strategy if needed.

execution._note: paper_trade=true skips actual Binance order placement but logs everything as if real.
